genZNote: Multiplies in the fridge. Genuinely. Cold storage is not the safety net you think it is.

morphology.arrangement: Single cells or short chains, resembling diphtheroids
morphology.motility: Motile with characteristic tumbling motility at 20-25°C; non-motile at 37°C

habitat.naturalHabitat: Soil, water, decaying vegetation, and the GI tract of many animals
habitat.hostAssociation: Foodborne pathogen; can cross the placental and blood-brain barriers
habitat.environmentalOccurrence: Widespread in the environment; notably able to grow at refrigeration temperatures (4°C)
habitat.reservoir: Soil, water, animals, contaminated food (unpasteurized dairy, deli meats, soft cheeses)

microscopy.appearance: Gram-positive short rods, may resemble diphtheroids or streptococci

culture.media: Blood agar; cold enrichment in broth at 4°C improves recovery
culture.growthCharacteristics: Grows over a wide temperature range (1-45°C) — psychrotrophic
culture.hemolysis: Narrow zone of beta-hemolysis on blood agar

identificationClues: Characteristic tumbling motility at room temperature
Narrow beta-hemolytic zone on blood agar
Grows at refrigeration temperatures — cold enrichment aids isolation
CAMP test positive with S. aureus

diseases: Sepsis and meningitis in neonates, elderly, and immunocompromised
virulenceFactors: ActA (intracellular actin-based motility for cell-to-cell spread)
clinicalImportance.transmission: Foodborne — unpasteurized dairy, deli meats, soft cheeses, contaminated produce; transplacental transmission to fetus
clinicalImportance.epidemiology: One of the few bacteria able to cross the placental barrier; pregnant individuals, neonates, elderly, and immunocompromised patients are at highest risk of severe disease
clinicalImportance.labSignificance: Ability to grow and remain motile at refrigeration temperatures distinguishes it from most other food pathogens

examFacts.keyBiochemicalReaction: Catalase positive, tumbling motility at room temperature
examFacts.importantDisease: Listeriosis, neonatal meningitis, foodborne illness in pregnancy
examFacts.distinguishingFeature: Grows and multiplies at refrigerator temperatures, unlike most foodborne pathogens
